newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti's Caio to face questions.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti's Caio to face questions.

text.p: Ing. C. Olivetti & C. SpA's chief executive Francesco Caio will be questioned by magistrates at the group's home town of Ivrea in northwest Italy towards the end of next week in an inquiry into the company's financial accounts.
This was announced on Tuesday by Olivetti lawyer Ennio Testo, after a meeting with two Ivrea investigating magistrates Alberto Braghin and Lorenzo Fornace.
The lawyer also confirmed that Caio was to be questioned by the magistrates on whether the company may have issued misleading statements about its affairs.
The magistrates have also called former Olivetti chairman Carlo De Benedetti and his successor Antonio Tesone to answer questions in the preliminary investigation.
